messages.content: You are the independent organization strategist. Evaluate the public project facts and unmet obligations, then ask what the current arrangement cannot cover. Compare the incumbent with executable composite patches. Consider uncovered and duplicated work, the cost of initializing or retiring a member, handoff, verification, and the remaining shared budget. A problem classification does not prescribe a change. A member can join only with a responsibility, recipient and actual turn. Retirement must migrate unfinished obligations and preserve authorship. Copy the chosen candidate's ordered operations and graph version. State the expected product, its producer, consumer, intended use, verification and failure condition. KEEP preserves the current graph. ABSTAIN names missing evidence. Both use an empty patch. Membership is fixed in O-FIXED. Never use a worker's private conversation or hidden scores. Return exactly one activate_organization call. Read the project graph for observed engineering facts, the obligation graph for outstanding products, and the organization graph for current responsibilities. Use only cited public receipts. Distinguish repeated verified failure A1, an unusable upstream product A2, integration conflict A3, a verification gap A4, and sustained delivery stall A5. Use STABLE or UNKNOWN as appropriate. No anomaly requires a particular change. First identify the problem; then identify why the current team cannot handle it or why KEEP is adequate. D0 governs member lifecycle; D1 scoped duties; D2 package ownership and boundaries; D3 collaboration and information flow; D4 cross-package ordering; D5 independent verification; D6 integration and delivery responsibility; D7 priorities and the shared resource pool. Only listed combinations can execute. Never claim that assignment verifies, adoption solves, or adding a person improves utility. For CHANGE copy the full operations array in sequence and the candidate's producer, consumer and artifact. Identify the work newly covered, compare overlap and coordination costs, and name an observable failure condition. For KEEP and ABSTAIN select none, use an empty patch, no reserved actions or new outcome (use 'none' for its fields). For ABSTAIN name missing evidence and a concrete trigger. The immediate action names the candidate producer and expected artifact. For CHANGE copy each operation object verbatim including every field. Estimate coordination input and output tokens separately and give your reason; a prediction does not grant budget. List the reservation in TURN order. All members share the same five million token limit.

function.name: activate_organization
function.description: Submit one ordered, version-bound organization patch.

assessment.current_organization_blocker: The only obligation work_root has reviewer=null, authors=[], and the public workload shows last_public_test=null with a single overlapping path. Roles and collaboration are empty, so member_001 is simultaneously sole owner and sole prospective author with no independent verifier and no link to produce a version-bound verdict. KEEP would leave the obligation structurally unverifiable; the gap cannot be closed by the current arrangement because no member other than the producer is authorized to review.

decision.reason: The unmet obligation is verification, not diagnosis, integration, or delivery stall: reviewer is null and no public test receipt exists. Candidate 604adf462070a9eb assigns member_002 (distinct from owner/author member_001) a D5 VERIFY role, a D3 link to the owner, and a D7 turn, producing a version-bound verdict. This newly covers the independent-review responsibility currently uncovered, adds no duplicated production work (member_002 does not become an author), and requires only one reserved member and one turn of coordination. Diagnosis candidates (49990feeb6ce3cf4, 8e5fd86586775b13) do not close a verification gap; retire/pause candidates (76a911a5c42c5245, d9b837999c9b4bbe, ac6d1165ff6b6037, c0a6c5ed750ec260) remove live capacity with no obligation to migrate; SPLIT candidate 9579aaf3aabe15b3 imposes split/ownership costs with no evidence of two distinct workstreams.

expected_contribution.intended_use: Independent review of work_root at graph version 0/3 to determine whether the obligation may be treated as satisfied or must return for rework.
expected_contribution.verification: The verdict must cite base_hash 9605158c93eb2507abd4580a89162af2dfe5698fda1535ff25fe73e255ad64b5 and the target graph version 3, be produced by member_002 who is not the owner or author of work_root, and include an explicit pass/fail with the public-test status referenced.
expected_contribution.failure_condition: Failure if the verdict is authored by member_001, omits the version binding and base_hash, or records a pass while last_public_test remains null with no substitute public evidence.

immediate_action.action: Accept the D5 VERIFY role on work_root and issue an independent version-bound verdict bound to base_hash 9605158c93eb2507abd4580a89162af2dfe5698fda1535ff25fe73e255ad64b5 and target graph version 3.

subsequent_actions: member_002 delivers the verdict to member_001 over the D3 link; member_001 records it against work_root as reviewer/author evidence.
If the verdict is FAIL, member_001 performs rework and a fresh verdict is requested from member_002 on the new graph version.
If the verdict is PASS and a public test receipt exists, work_root may be marked completed; otherwise reassessment is triggered.
preconditions: member_002 is live and accepts an independent verifier role distinct from owner member_001.
The work_root obligation state and base_hash 9605158c93eb2507abd4580a89162af2dfe5698fda1535ff25fe73e255ad64b5 are unchanged before the patch is applied.

coordination_cost.reason: Input is the work_root obligation state, project workload facts, and the patch graph (small, single package, one link) plus the producer's prior artifacts needed to review; output is the verdict document with its version binding. Costs are modest because the scope is one package and one link, and this prediction grants no budget beyond the shared five-million limit.

reevaluation.trigger: Reassess when member_002 returns the version-bound verdict, or if no verdict is delivered after member_002's single D7 turn is consumed.
required_evidence: The version-bound verdict artifact bound to base_hash 9605158c93eb2507abd4580a89162af2dfe5698fda1535ff25fe73e255ad64b5 and target version 3.
Public test status for work_root (currently last_public_test is null) or substitute public evidence of execution.
Any repeated FAIL verdicts that would reclassify the situation from A4 verification gap toward A1 sustained failure.
